name: bazario
description: Bazario: an Amazon.com-style store (take-home). Modular NestJS API + Next.js web.

scripts.setup: npm install && docker compose up -d --wait && npm --prefix api ci && npm --prefix web ci && node scripts/init-env.mjs && npm --prefix api run db:migrate && npm --prefix api run db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix api run start:dev" "npm --prefix web run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix api run typecheck && npm --prefix web run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix api run build && npm --prefix web run build
